notes.title: Connection Solutions and Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the player to disconnect from the game.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented some interactive UI s from appearing.
[/list]

Now when you get the keys, you can see which key you have by pressing the [b]"J" [/b] key. [b]"Create Room"[/b] is active again.

If you encounter bugs in the game or want to make suggestions, please visit our discord channel; [url=https://discord.gg/aNWNZJjE]Mirror Spirits Discord Channel[/url]

notes.title: We Are Aware Of Connection Errors
notes.content: We are aware of connection errors. To fix these bugs, we'll be keeping [u]game[/u] closed until April 11, 2022 [b]02:00 PT[/b].
